      if (globalThis.qaManifestOriginalControl) {
        // Passive disposable-test observation only. Original qaSignInTrace stays unchanged.
        (() => {
          const records = [], faults = [], identities = new WeakMap();
          let nextIdentity = 0, dropped = 0, faultDropped = 0, sequence = 0;
          const safeIds = new Set(['accountSignInForm', 'accountEmail', 'accountPassword', 'keepAccountSignedIn', 'accountSyncHelp', 'accountSyncDetail', 'accountSyncControls', 'settingsBody', 'settingsModal', 'closeSettingsBtn']);
          const fault = stage => { if (faults.length < 8) faults.push({ stage, atMs: performance.now() }); else faultDropped++; };
          const identity = node => { if (!node) return null; if (!identities.has(node)) identities.set(node, ++nextIdentity); return identities.get(node); };
          const finite = value => Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
          const rect = element => {
            if (!element?.getBoundingClientRect) return null;
            const box = element.getBoundingClientRect();
            return Object.fromEntries(['x', 'y', 'width', 'height', 'top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'].map(key => [key, finite(box[key])]));
          };
          const node = element => {
            if (!element || element.nodeType !== 1) return null;
            const style = getComputedStyle(element);
            return {
              identity: identity(element), tag: element.tagName,
              id: safeIds.has(element.id) ? element.id : null,
              role: ['button', 'dialog', 'form', 'checkbox', 'textbox', 'tab', 'tablist', 'navigation'].includes(element.getAttribute('role')) ? element.getAttribute('role') : null,
              type: element.tagName === 'BUTTON' && ['button', 'submit', 'reset'].includes(element.getAttribute('type')) ? element.getAttribute('type') : null,
              connected: element.isConnected, hidden: element.hidden, disabled: Boolean(element.disabled), inert: Boolean(element.inert),
              rect: rect(element), scrollTop: finite(element.scrollTop), scrollLeft: finite(element.scrollLeft),
              style: Object.fromEntries(['display', 'visibility', 'pointer-events', 'position', 'z-index', 'transform', 'overflow-x', 'overflow-y', 'scroll-padding-top', 'scroll-padding-bottom'].map(key => [key, style.getPropertyValue(key)])),
            };
          };
          const point = (label, x, y) => ({ label, x: finite(x), y: finite(y),
            stack: Number.isFinite(x) && Number.isFinite(y) ? document.elementsFromPoint(x, y).slice(0, 7).map(node) : [] });
          const copyLength = id => document.getElementById(id)?.textContent.length ?? null;
          const snapshot = (kind, event = null, mutation = null) => {
            const form = document.getElementById('accountSignInForm');
            const submit = form?.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
            const box = rect(submit), viewport = globalThis.visualViewport;
            const x = finite(event?.clientX), y = finite(event?.clientY);
            return {
              sequence: ++sequence, kind, atMs: performance.now(), timeOrigin: performance.timeOrigin,
              event: event ? { type: event.type, trusted: event.isTrusted, defaultPrevented: event.defaultPrevented,
                eventPhase: event.eventPhase, button: finite(event.button), buttons: finite(event.buttons),
                clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerType: ['mouse', 'touch', 'pen', ''].includes(event.pointerType) ? event.pointerType : null,
                target: node(event.target), relatedTarget: node(event.relatedTarget) } : null,
              mutation, form: node(form), submit: node(submit), activeElement: node(document.activeElement),
              points: [point('event', x, y), ...(box ? [point('submit-center', box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2)] : [])],
              helpLength: copyLength('accountSyncHelp'), detailLength: copyLength('accountSyncDetail'),
              helperModulePresent: Boolean(globalThis.NOTHINGSPORTS_ACCOUNT_INDICATOR_APP),
              helperControllerPresent: typeof accountIndicatorController !== 'undefined' && Boolean(accountIndicatorController),
              activeTab: typeof activeTab !== 'undefined' && ['feed', 'events', 'follow', 'live', 'match-centre'].includes(activeTab) ? activeTab : null,
              followPaddingScopeMatches: document.documentElement.matches('html:has(#listView.follow-view>.follow-navigation)'),
              viewport: { innerWidth, innerHeight, scrollX, scrollY, devicePixelRatio,
                visual: viewport ? Object.fromEntries(['width', 'height', 'offsetTop', 'offsetLeft', 'pageTop', 'pageLeft', 'scale'].map(key => [key, finite(viewport[key])])) : null },
              containers: ['html', 'body', '#settingsModal', '#settingsModal .onboarding-panel', '#settingsBody', '#settingsModal .onboarding-head'].map(selector => ({ selector, element: node(document.querySelector(selector)) })),
            };
          };
          const record = (kind, event = null, mutation = null) => {
            try {
              const entry = snapshot(kind, event, mutation);
              if (records.length === 64) { records.shift(); dropped++; }
              records.push(entry);
            } catch (_) { fault(kind); }
          };
          const belongs = target => Boolean(target?.closest?.('#accountSignInForm'));
          for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'mousedown', 'mouseup', 'click', 'submit', 'focusin', 'focusout']) {
            document.addEventListener(type, event => { if (belongs(event.target)) record('capture:' + type, event); }, { capture: true, passive: true });
          }
          // Bubble sees prevention performed by the real target handlers; it never prevents an event.
          for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'pointerup', 'mousedown', 'mouseup', 'click', 'submit']) {
            document.addEventListener(type, event => { if (belongs(event.target)) record('bubble:' + type, event); }, { passive: true });
          }
          document.addEventListener('scroll', event => {
            if (event.target === document || event.target?.closest?.('#settingsModal')) record('scroll');
          }, { capture: true, passive: true });
          const body = document.getElementById('settingsBody');
          const relevant = element => Boolean(element?.matches?.('#accountSyncHelp,#accountSyncDetail,#accountSignInForm,#accountSignInForm button[type="submit"]') || element?.closest?.('#accountSyncHelp,#accountSyncDetail,#accountSignInForm') || element?.querySelector?.('#accountSyncHelp,#accountSyncDetail,#accountSignInForm'));
          if (body) new MutationObserver(batch => {
            try {
              const selected = batch.filter(change => relevant(change.target.nodeType === 1 ? change.target : change.target.parentElement) || [...change.addedNodes, ...change.removedNodes].some(relevant));
              if (selected.length) record('mutation', null, selected.slice(0, 6).map(change => ({
                type: change.type, targetIdentity: identity(change.target), attribute: change.attributeName,
                added: change.addedNodes.length, removed: change.removedNodes.length,
              })));
            } catch (_) { fault('mutation'); }
          }).observe(body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['disabled', 'hidden', 'inert', 'class', 'style'] });
          globalThis.qaSignInGeometryCapture = () => {
            let final = null;
            try { final = snapshot('failure-final'); } catch (_) { fault('failure-final'); }
            return { schema: 'account-signin-hit.passive.v1', capacity: 64, records: [...records], dropped,
              final, faults: [...faults], faultDropped, limits: 'Disposable-test passive observations; layout reads can perturb timing. No entered values, password lengths, text, account IDs or tokens captured.' };
          };
        })();
      }
